title: Meta is paying to peek at how you use their latest AI model
description: For its new Muse Spark model, intended for operating coding and other agents, Meta is offering an explicit discount averaging out to about 95% for users who "contribute" to the development of future models by sharing their prompts and model outputs.
author: Tim Fernholz

title: OpenAI launches Astra, its powerful (and controversial) new model
description: OpenAI claims that Astra represents "a new frontier on computer and browser use," and that it handles tasks with unmatched "speed, accuracy, and safety."
author: Lucas Ropek

title: Ollie is betting its focus on privacy can help it win the AI assistant race
description: The family-focused AI assistant wants access to the details of your everyday life, but says it won’t use that data to train AI models or share it with others.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Google’s latest AI weather model gives you no excuse to forget your umbrella
description: WeatherNext 3 is the latest wave of a sea change in meteorology brought out by deep learning techniques. Google says it will start feeding into weather information users see in search, Google Maps, and Gemini.
author: Tim Fernholz

title: Nvidia confirms it will buy Hugging Face for $12.9 billion
description: Nvidia said Hugging Face hosts over 3 million models and is used by over 18 million developers.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: The Builders Stage brings practical strategies for scaling startups to TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
description: The Builders Stage is returning to TechCrunch Disrupt, bringing together founders, startup operators, and investors for practical conversations on what it takes to build and scale.
author: TechCrunch Events

title: Palo Alto Networks paid $500M for Thrive-backed Console, sources say
description: The acquisition also leaves Sequoia-backed Serval as the de facto startup leader in AI IT service automation, industry watchers believe.
author: Marina Temkin

title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026’s new Real World AI Stage features Nvidia, robots, and extinct animals
description: On our new Real World AI stage, we’ll be focusing on the intersection between the digital and physical, and all the ways we’ll continue to see a blending of the two.
author: TechCrunch Events

title: OpenAI’s new reasoning technique alarms AI safety experts
description: OpenAI’s new Astra model will use “recurrent depth,” a technique that allows the model to operate outside of the sequential thinking that characterizes most reasoning models.
author: Russell Brandom

title: Pangram’s Max Spero on why AI detection is harder than ‘Real or Fake’
description: The internet has a trust problem, and it’s not just because social media feeds are filling up with AI slop. AI-generated text and images are now making their way into job applications, product reviews, and even insurance claims, leaving platforms and users alike scrambling to figure out what’s real.  A handful of startups have cropped up in the past couple of […]
author: Theresa Loconsolo

title: We’re ‘dangerously close’ to dead internet theory, says Pangram’s CEO
description: The internet has a trust problem, and it’s not just because social media feeds are filling up with AI slop. AI-generated text and images are now making their way into job applications, product reviews, and even insurance claims, leaving platforms and users alike scrambling to figure out what’s real.  A handful of startups have cropped up in the past couple of […]
author: Rebecca Bellan, Theresa Loconsolo

title: US government sides with OpenAI on issue of training LLMs on copyrighted material
description:
"The United States has a strong interest in continuing to develop a robust and competitive
artificial intelligence industry that sets the standard for the practice and procedure of AI use
globally," the brief reads.
author: Amanda Silberling

title: Wonderful more than doubles its valuation to $5B in under 6 months
description: Wonderful said it will use its $550 million Series C funding to develop products faster, expand its FDE teams, and meet demand for its products.
author: Ram Iyer

title: India’s richest man now wants to turn aging computers into AI-ready PCs
description: Jio is betting it can turn an aging computer into an AI-ready PC for as little as about $11 for two months.
author: Jagmeet Singh

title: HiddenLayer nabs $100M as enterprises rush to secure their AI deployments
description: Security companies are scrambling to build products that can monitor not just agents but also the tools and add-ons they use.
author: Ram Iyer

title: PSA: Amazon’s shopping AI can now tell you if that message is a scam
description: Amazon is adding a scam-detection feature to Alexa for Shopping that can verify whether suspicious emails, texts, and other messages actually came from the retailer.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Adobe acquires Indian market intelligence startup Rilo
description: This is Adobe's second acquisition out of India after Rephrase.ai in 2023
author: Ivan Mehta

title: OpenAI faces 30 more lawsuits tied to Tumbler Ridge shooting
description: Edelson PC is filing 30 new lawsuits against OpenAI over the Tumbler Ridge shooting, escalating claims to aiding and abetting and naming Chris Lehane, though evidence remains unconfirmed.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: AfterQuery reportedly becomes Y Combinator’s fastest-ever unicorn, now valued at $3.2B
description: AI model-training startup AfterQuery has reportedly raised a round that valued it at $3.2 billion, just five months after announcing its $30 million Series A at a $300 million valuation in April.
author: Julie Bort

title: Open AI’s Astra model is on the way — and very good at breaking into computer systems
description: OpenAI previewed the precautions it is taking as it prepares to release Astra, its newest, cyber-critical LLM.
author: Tim Fernholz

title: Google’s Android update tackles motion sickness, accessibility, and more
description: While some of the features see Google playing catch-up to Apple, which already offers similar features for iPhone users, others specifically leverage Gemini to provide various improvements.
author: Lauren Forristal

title: Anthropic’s new Fable release is cheaper, less restrictive
description: Fable 5.1 includes changes meant to reduce token cost and false-positive restrictions from the model's safeguards.
author: Russell Brandom

title: Google’s answer to Canva is an AI tool where you prompt instead of design
description: With Google Pics, Google is pushing deeper into the creative software market dominated by Canva and Adobe, but with a distinctly AI-first approach.
author: Sarah Perez

title: ChatGPT Health adds Epic integration for clinicians to import patient data
description: OpenAI said that the integration provides read-only access to health records for clinicians.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Sequoia-incubated Empirik launches with $21M to predict outages before they happen
description: The startup wants to do for IT infrastructure what Cursor did for software engineering.
author: Marina Temkin

title: Amazon Alexa can now alert you when something new might tempt you to shop
description: Amazon is adding a new Alexa-powered feature called “Update Me When” that can send personalized alerts about product launches, tours, books, shows, and other events that could trigger a purchase.
author: Sarah Perez

title: AIR raises $50M to help companies vet the skills and add-ons AI agents use
description: AIR's platform can discover agents running at a company, continuously vets any skills and add-ons they use, and blocks any unwanted behavior.
author: Ram Iyer

title: Fambot introduces an ‘AI chief of staff’ for families
description: Fambot is building an AI “chief of staff” to help families manage the emails, calendars, school updates, sports schedules, and other logistics of raising kids.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Apple shares ‘shocking evidence’ against former employee accused of stealing company data for OpenAI
description: Apple says it has evidence that a former employee destroyed evidence of data theft after learning he was under investigation.
author: Amanda Silberling

title: The Pentagon now has its own version of ChatGPT and Grok
description: Versions of OpenAI's ChatGPT and SpaceXAI's Grok will join Google's Gemini on the Pentagon's central portal for AI tools.
author: Kirsten Korosec
